questions.prompt: Compound interest is calculated on the principal AND on the interest already earned.
questions.explanation: That is what makes it grow faster than simple interest.

questions.prompt: Simple interest grows faster than compound interest for the same P, R and T.
questions.explanation: Compound grows faster because interest earns further interest.

questions.prompt: The hire-purchase price is usually higher than the cash price.
questions.explanation: Instalments include interest, so the total exceeds the cash price.

questions.prompt: Paying by hire purchase is always cheaper than paying the cash price.
questions.explanation: Hire purchase costs more overall because of the interest added.

questions.prompt: To convert a currency, first find the value of one unit, then multiply.
questions.explanation: Find 1 unit's value, then multiply by the amount.

questions.prompt: A vehicle's value falls over time; this fall is called depreciation.
questions.explanation: Depreciation is the fall in a vehicle's market value.

questions.prompt: Depreciation means a vehicle's value increases every year.
questions.explanation: Depreciation is a FALL in value over time.

questions.prompt: By Islamic law the widow's share of the estate is one-eighth (1/8).
questions.explanation: Widow = 1/8; the rest goes to the children.

questions.prompt: By Islamic law a daughter inherits twice the share of a son.
questions.explanation: It is the SON who inherits twice a daughter's share.

questions.prompt: If partners invest equal amounts for the same time, the profit is divided equally.
questions.explanation: Equal investment and time -> equal profit share.

questions.prompt: When partners invest different amounts, the profit is still always split equally.
questions.explanation: Different investment -> profit split in the RATIO of investments.

questions.prompt: The premium for insurance is a percentage of the insured value.
The amount A in simple interest equals P + I.
questions.explanation: A = P + I for simple interest.

questions.prompt: In compound interest you find the interest first, then the amount.
questions.explanation: The formula gives the amount A first; subtract P to get the interest.
